    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AppInfo
    Holds application-wide constants that are reused by every package.
    Book
    A single book in the library, identified by a unique ID.
    BookStatus
    The three loan states a library book can have.
    LibraryException
    Checked exception raised for validation errors and missing books.
    LibraryFrame
    Polished Swing window for adding, viewing, updating, deleting and issuing books.
    LibraryFrame.Theme
    Single place for the GUI palette, fonts and look-and-feel setup.
    LibraryService
    In-memory business logic for the library.
    LibraryServiceTest
    Plain-Java test runner for the eight required LibraryService cases.
    Main
    Application entry point that prints the group members, applies the system look and feel and launches the themed Swing window on the Event Dispatch Thread.
